description: The lifted L2 of the reference Fusion 360 pocket_drill_arc.apt toolpath (Flow A). Exercises the IR codec on a channel-rich, oriented toolpath with multiaxis orientations, circular arcs, modal spindle power, tool numbers, cycle expansion, and dwells. NOT oracle-backed: external oracle qualification is Layer D-adjacent (docs/28-apt-irbcam-dialects.md §10.4). No expected.gcode is emitted since G-code is not the target dialect for this vector.
name: apt_fusion_lift
